envelope.description: Make executeTool ask before it runs

body.title: Make executeTool ask before it runs
body.summary: In src/daemon/tools/executor.ts run s2's input check, then the approval step from t5: ask the broker for the request, and on a decline, timeout, no client or cancel return a failed result with failure kind denied and the denial reason, without running the tool. Remove the 'auto-approving' branch. Set caller at the two ToolDeps builders that reach executeTool (src/analyze/context/driver.ts, src/agent/providers/ollama.ts). The broker is reached through a daemon-level accessor so executeTool keeps its signature.
acceptanceChecks: a declined, timed-out, no-client or cancelled answer returns failure kind denied with that reason and execute is never called
an approved call runs and returns the tool's own result unchanged
a second destructive call after an approved one asks again with a new request id
a bad input is rejected before any prompt
the 'auto-approving' log line and branch are gone
tool ids and input schemas are unchanged
